set-build-build.might-offense.name: The Long Arm of the Fall
set-build-build.might-offense.flavor: Every piece of it is heavier than it looks and hangs a little lower than it should. The swing is not the point. The point is what the ground does after.

set-build-build.might-defense.name: Standing Order of the Last Rank
set-build-build.might-defense.flavor: Nobody in the back rank has been told to fall back, and nobody has asked. The line is where the line was told to be, and the plating is thick enough that the question does not come up twice.

set-build-build.might-balance.name: Levy and Larder
set-build-build.might-balance.flavor: A muster roll stitched into the belt lining, and a tally of what the muster ate. The second list is why the first one is still accurate in the third week.
